```text
--- rough-ride hunt (copy this block unchanged) ---
rough-ride hunt | 5m11s | run 20261112-182228-hunt-3dc4 | 5 confirmed, 0 dropped on re-run
target: http://localhost:3790

Findings (each reproduced twice from scratch)
1. HIGH   Failed journal entry delete removes the entry from the list anyway
   where: /plants/:id Journal section (DELETE /api/journal/:id)
   expected: When the delete request fails, the entry stays in the list next to the error, because it still exists on the server.
   saw: {"visible":0,"alerts":["Injected 500"]}
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-182228-hunt-3dc4/probes/delete-fail.mjs (expectation "failed-delete-keeps-entry-visible")
2. MEDIUM Malformed journal response on the plant page is drawn as junk entries with no error
   where: /plants/:id Journal section (GET /api/journal?plant_id=)
   expected: A visible error saying the journal could not be loaded.
   saw: {"url":"/plants/1","alerts":[],"j":["Journal","2 entries","New entry","Date","Entry","500 characters left","Add entry","Entries, newest first","–","Edit","entry from –","Delete","entry from –","–"],"pageErrors":[],"hits":1}
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-182228-hunt-3dc4/probes/detail-load-faults.mjs (expectation "journal-load-malformed-shows-error")
3. MEDIUM Bad journal payload on the plant page shows 'No journal entries yet' while the badge says 2 entries
   where: /plants/:id Journal section
   expected: An error, not an empty state.
   saw: {"url":"/plants/1","alerts":[],"j":["Journal","2 entries","New entry","Date","Entry","500 characters left","Add entry","Entries, newest first","No journal entries yet","Note what you see: first shoots, pests, the weather.","Garden Log · a journal for one garden"],"pageErrors":[],"hits":1}
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-182228-hunt-3dc4/probes/detail-load-faults.mjs (expectation "journal-load-empty-object-shows-error")
4. MEDIUM Journal page shows a malformed response as 14 blank entries
   where: /journal (GET /api/journal)
   expected: A visible load error.
   saw: {"url":"/journal","alerts":["14 entries"],"text":["Journal","The latest notes from across the garden, newest first.","Write in a plant's journal","Search","14 entries","–","–","–","–","–","–","–","–","–","–","–","–","–","–","Garden Log · a journal for one garden"],"pageErrors":[]}
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-182228-hunt-3dc4/probes/journal-page-shape.mjs (expectation "journal-page-malformed-shows-error")
5. LOW    Search over 80 characters shows a raw validation message and hides all results
   where: /journal search box
   expected: The search box limits input to what the API accepts, or explains the limit in plain words.
   saw: {"alerts":["Query.q: String should have at most 80 characters"],"text":["Journal","The latest notes from across the garden, newest first.","Write in a plant's journal","Search","Clear search","Query.q: String should have at most 80 characters","Garden Log · a journal for one garden"]}
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-182228-hunt-3dc4/probes/journal-page.mjs (expectation "long-search-not-raw-error")
--- end of rough-ride hunt ---
```
